2 لطّخهُ He defiled, befouled, polluted, dirtied, soiled, smeared, besmeared, daubed, bedaubed, bespattered, [rubbed over, or overspread,] or splashed, him or it, much. (Msb.) [See also 1.] ―
-b2- He daubed him over with perfume &c. (S, K, art. ضمخ, &c.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
